mapper.sql: P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND P.GOODS_STATUS = 'ON_SALE' AND P.STOCK_QUANTITY > 0 AND (P.DISPLAY_START_DATE IS NULL OR P.DISPLAY_START_DATE <= NOW()) AND (P.DISPLAY_END_DATE IS NULL OR P.DISPLAY_END_DATE >= NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT I.GOODS_NO, I.QUANTITY, CASE WHEN THEN P.GOODS_NAME_KO ELSE '현재 구매할 수 없는 상품' END GOODS_NAME_KO, CASE WHEN THEN (SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM goods_image WHERE GOODS_NO = P.GOODS_NO ORDER BY REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) END REPRESENTATIVE_IMAGE_URL, CASE WHEN THEN COALESCE(P.DISCOUNT_PRICE, P.SALE_PRICE) END UNIT_PRICE, CASE WHEN THEN P.STOCK_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END STOCK_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AVAILABLE FROM cart_item I INNER JOIN goods_info P ON P.GOODS_NO = I.GOODS_NO WHERE I.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY I.REG_DATE DESC, I.GOODS_NO DESC
SELECT P.GOODS_NO, P.STOCK_QUANTITY FROM goods_info P WHERE P.GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo} AND FOR UPDATE
SELECT QUANTITY FROM cart_item WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (USER_NO, GOODS_NO, QUANTITY) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{goodsNo}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET QUANTITY = #{quantity}, UPDT_DATE = NOW() WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo}
